_comment: FALLBACK ONLY -- used when the search_configs DB table has no enabled rows for this vertical. The real control surface is the Discovery page: describe what you want, review the interpreted filters, save it, then press 'To discovery' to promote it into a search_configs row, which takes precedence over everything here. Keywords are matched as exact phrases, so a term means that term.
_yield_note: Measured against HN's last 30 days on 2026-09-11: 'Launch HN' = 12 real funded companies; 'Show HN' = 3673 (a firehose of hobby projects, deliberately NOT used); 'community manager' / 'growth marketing' / 'seed round' = 0. Keywords here are chosen for precision over volume -- a lead you have to hand-filter costs more than it is worth.

configs.name: Funded launches (any industry) - a company at its launch moment
configs._why: Launch HN is reserved for YC-backed companies announcing themselves. Funded, named, real, and launching is exactly when a team needs community/social/content help -- regardless of what they build.

configs.name: Recent YC batches mentioned outside their launch post
configs._why: Catches the same class of company when it surfaces in a non-Launch-HN thread. Roll these forward as new batches ship (S26 -> W27 -> ...).

configs.name: Teams openly asking for marketing / community / growth help
configs._why: Zero yield on most days -- kept because it costs one API call and fires on the rare post that is a direct, explicit buying signal. Excludes the monthly 'Who is hiring?' mega-threads, which are one thread, not one company.
